Context: 4. Concessions for Family

- (iii) Children including legally adopted children, stepchildren and children taken as wards subject to the following conditions:-  
Unmarried Son  
Daughter  
Son suffering from permanent disability of any kind (physical or mental)  
- Till he starts earning, or attains the age of 25 years, whichever is earlier. .·.
- Till she starts earning or gets married, whichever is earlier, irrespective of age-limit.
- No age-limit.
